The climate in Niš

Niš is about 200 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 30°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −3°C. Around 680 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in June (about 76 mm). The highest temperature in Niš in 2015–2024 was 39°C (14 August 2024) and the lowest −22°C (20 January 2016).

Best time to visit Niš

The most pleasant weather in Niš is usually in June and September: average highs are between 25°C and 26°C, with up to 11 days of rain a month. In January nights are frosty (below −3°C on average) and snow is common.
